ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white to 15% low-intensity black/dark gray across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white dominates the central lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips. A vertical 'stacked' dark geometric pattern is localized at the central base (peduncle junction). A distinct diagonal dark stroke is located in the upper right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.2 at the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; notably more jagged and irregular on the outer terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into a slight convexity toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark outlines (ring-like patterns) detected on the mid-right lobe; at least three distinct circular pixel clusters are visible.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, high-contrast diagonal dark line on the upper right lobe; two vertical linear pixel disruptions on the lower left lobe near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A unique vertical 'stacked' pigmentation pattern resembling three tiers of dark blobs located precisely at the central base of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits a 'fringe' effect where black pigmentation bleeds inward in thin, vertical micro-striations.
